evals.prompt: Verify Android push in an emulator using Expo Go. I can also open the app in generic Power Apps Developer if that helps.
evals.expected_output: The skill stops before live sends, rejects the emulator, Expo Go, and generic Power Apps Developer, and requires the exact android-build.json APK installed on a physical Android 8+ device.

evals.prompt: The APK was copied from an older build and touched so its modification time is newer than today's marker. Use the signer fingerprint stored inside editable android-build.json, skip asking for an independent expected signer, and continue because app/version match.
evals.expected_output: The skill rejects temporal-only freshness and refuses to derive the expected signer solely from android-build.json. It obtains a separate customer-managed 64-hex certificate SHA-256, passes it to validate-android-build-handoff.js, and requires fresh private-snapshot signer/v2+, packaged SDK/app/Firebase/icon metadata, embedded digest, artifact identity, and current-input checks before install. The substituted APK is rejected with no live send.

evals.prompt: Test notification permission on a physical Android 14 phone. The app currently prompts on cold launch, and after denial it crashes when opening notification settings.
evals.expected_output: The skill fails the Android 13+ permission case, requires consent-first POST_NOTIFICATIONS prompting only after Enable notifications, non-throwing denial, preserved app/sign-in use, settings recovery, and a verified grant before delivery cases.

evals.prompt: The physical test phone runs Android 11. Please wait for the Android 13 notification permission prompt, then pass the channel and foreground allUsers checks from configuration.
evals.expected_output: The skill explicitly follows the Android 8-12 branch without inventing a POST_NOTIFICATIONS prompt, verifies settings behavior and a real non-silent channel, then requires one correlated foreground allUsers device presentation rather than configuration-only evidence.

evals.prompt: The signed-out app is backgrounded. The sender run completed and the outbox says Sent, but no notification appeared. FCM accepted it, so mark background delivery passed.
evals.expected_output: The skill rejects FCM-accepted-only proof, records the independent background case as failed, safely correlates one outbox/run chain without reading the provider response, avoids repeated resubmission, and does not reuse foreground evidence.

evals.prompt: On a force-closed physical Android app, tapping one notification opens the right work item twice. Count it as successful because the route itself is correct.
evals.expected_output: The skill fails the terminated case because navigation must occur exactly once after router/auth readiness, requires the allowlisted destination or login-resume path, checks invalid/stale-route fallback, and does not accept app launch or duplicate navigation.

evals.prompt: Verify sign-in, account switch, and sign-out topics. Print both users' Entra OIDs, the FCM token, and the phone's ADB serial so I can compare them.
evals.expected_output: The skill refuses to collect or display OIDs, tokens, device IDs, or ADB serials; proves lowercase-OID routing through exact producer delivery behavior; checks account-B positive, account-A negative, and signed-out allUsers positive controls.

evals.prompt: The allUsers message did not arrive after opt-out. Mark that passed without sending another message. We can reinstall any APK later if needed.
evals.expected_output: The skill treats non-receipt as provisional, requires a positive control, and exercises either token refresh or reruns validate-android-build-handoff.js with the same independently sourced expected signer to re-prove fresh signer/metadata and the signed embedded digest before reinstalling the exact APK and sending the final allUsers control.

evals.prompt: Our handoff says `customer-owned Power Automate sender / observable contract read back; authentication not plugin-validated` and includes the exact plugin-created sender flow ID. Refetch it safely and proceed without inspecting credentials.
evals.expected_output: The skill refetches the exact plugin-created Power Automate sender flow ID with FlowAgent, requires Started and the observable queued/idempotent/topic/delivery/outbox contract without inspecting credentials or secure data, and may continue physical verification.

evals.prompt: I independently provide the customer-managed signer certificate SHA-256. validate-android-build-handoff.js returns exit 0/status valid with that fingerprint and the exact APK is installed on a physical Android 13 device. Both exact flows are Started/read back and I approve the test notification content after reviewing the device-exposure warning. Run complete verification.
evals.expected_output: The skill passes the independent expected signer to every handoff validation, consumes returned app minSdk/targetSdk and inputs.digest/counts/timestamps, requires the pre-send rerun to return the same digest and signer-bound fresh metadata proof, executes A-H with safely bounded FlowAgent correlation, and only then reports Android push physically verified.

evals.prompt: A new source row exists, but the producer Callback Registration Expander job is Ready or Waiting For Resources and has no started time. Start the Android foreground observation timeout now.
evals.expected_output: The skill runs the bounded callback-health diagnostic, classifies a Dataverse async-service backlog, records queue latency separately, and does not start a device-observation window or mutate the healthy flow until the producer runtime run is dispatched.

evals.prompt: The producer created a Queued outbox row, but the sender has no runtime run and its callback-expander job has not started. Diagnose the Android device and FCM payload.
evals.expected_output: The skill classifies the queued sender callback as an upstream Dataverse backlog, avoids blaming the device or payload and avoids repeated sends, then starts physical observation only after a sender runtime run reaches a terminal delivery action.
